OCR for scanned DGDs, loaded by portal/app.js only when an uploaded DGD has no readable text.
Everything runs in the browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js       tesseract.js 5.1.1 (npm), Apache-2.0
tesseract-core-*-lstm.wasm.js          tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (npm), Apache-2.0
eng.traineddata                        tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast, English, Apache-2.0
